xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4527: Re-review joins a verification worker started on the previous head and fails the new head on the old head's CI result

plan.title: Re-review joins a verification worker started on the previous head and fails the new head on the old head's CI result
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A re-review after a fix push joined the verification worker started on the previous head, because the review path treated every head as the same head; the worker then failed the new head with the old head's red CI result.
narratives.Proposal: Add one same-head rule (cloister/verification-head.ts): a later head is the launch head when it has not moved or is the worker's own target-branch sync merge; an agent commit is a moved head. The supervisor joins only on the same head and otherwise kills the old worker and starts fresh; the runner reads the CI test verdict for the head it verifies now.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to merge verification's exact-anchor join rule beyond using the shared classifier
- No change to isVerificationWorkerActive or deacon-lite recovery
- No change to the verification artifact head8 label

items.title: Add the shared same-head classifier for verification

expected_outputs: npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/verification-head.test.ts completes without errors

narrative.Action: classifyVerificationHead returns same, synced, moved or unknown for a later head against a launch head, per repo for polyrepo anchors.

items.title: Given the verification-head test repos, when classifyVerificationHead compares an unchanged head with the launch head, then it returns same
Given the verification-head test repos, when the later head is the worker's sync merge or a fast-forward on origin, then it returns synced, and an agent commit returns moved
Join a live verification worker only on the same head

expected_outputs: npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/verification-worker-supervisor-join.test.ts completes without errors

narrative.Action: runSupervisedVerificationInternal joins a live worker only when the requested head is its same or synced head; an agent commit kills it and starts fresh.

items.title: Given a live review-verification worker launched on head A, when a request arrives at agent commit B, then the supervisor kills the A worker and starts a fresh worker on B
Given a live review-verification worker whose only HEAD change is its own sync merge, when a duplicate request arrives, then the request joins the live worker
Read the CI test verdict for the head being verified

expected_outputs: npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/cloister/verification-tests-on-ci.test.ts completes without errors

narrative.Action: In ci tests mode the runner reads the CI test result for the launch head while HEAD is same or synced, otherwise for the current head.

items.title: Given CI recorded failed for head A and passed for head B, when verification of B reaches the ci-mode test gate, then test passes
Given a red CI head with only a real target-branch sync merge on top, when verification reaches the ci-mode test gate, then test fails with that head's CI verdict
Document when a re-review joins or restarts a live worker

expected_outputs: npm run lint:docs completes without errors

narrative.Action: Add the 'Same head: joining or restarting a live worker' subsection to the verification gate section.

items.title: Given docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, when the Same head subsection is read, then it states that a re-review joins a live worker on the same or synced head
Given docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, when the Same head subsection is read, then it states that an agent commit kills the live worker and starts a fresh one
